=== KEY TYPE MAPPING ===

Event (typeKey=128):
  key 4   = name (string) -- inherited from Component
  key 5   = parentId (uint) -- artboard-relative parent

OpenUrlEvent (typeKey=131) extends Event:
  key 248 = url (string) -- the URL to open on fire

CustomPropertyNumber (typeKey=127) -- numeric property on Event:
  key 4   = name (string)
  key 5   = parentId (uint) -- artboard-relative, points to parent Event
  key 243 = propertyValue (float64) -- the number value (e.g. Volume=80)

CustomPropertyBoolean (typeKey=129) -- boolean property on Event:
  key 4   = name (string)
  key 5   = parentId (uint)
  key 245 = propertyValue (bool) -- not emitted when false (default)

CustomPropertyString (typeKey=130) -- string property on Event:
  key 4   = name (string)
  key 5   = parentId (uint)
  key 246 = propertyValue (string) -- the string value (e.g. AudioFile="step.wav")

ListenerFireEvent (typeKey=168) -- SM listener action that fires an event:
  (no parentId -- belongs to current StateMachine context)
  key 389 = eventId (uint) -- artboard-relative index of the Event to fire

StateTransitionEvent (typeKey=169) -- fires an event on a state transition:
  key 392 = eventId (uint) -- artboard-relative index of the Event to fire
  key 393 = direction (uint) -- 0=enter (default, not emitted), 1=exit

=== AUDIO TRIGGER PATTERN ===
Audio in Rive uses a generic Rive Event (typeKey=128) with specific CustomProperty children:

  Event (typeKey=128)  name="<sound name>"
  +-- CustomPropertyBoolean (typeKey=129)  name="Stereo"    (is stereo? default false)
  +-- CustomPropertyString  (typeKey=130)  name="AudioFile" key=246  (file path / asset name)
  +-- CustomPropertyNumber  (typeKey=127)  name="Volume"    key=243  (0-100, 80 = default)

The event fires when:
  A) A StateMachineListener triggers -> ListenerFireEvent (typeKey=168) with k389=event_artboard_idx
  B) A state transition occurs -> StateTransitionEvent (typeKey=169) with k392=event_artboard_idx

=== TWO AUDIO PATTERNS IN RIVE ===

Pattern A -- Event-based audio trigger (this file, no embedded bytes):
  - Event(128) with child CustomPropertyString(130) "AudioFile" = external file path
  - Audio file loaded by the Rive WASM runtime from the host application
  - typeKeys needed: 127, 128, 129, 130, 168 -- ALL ALREADY REGISTERED in gen_registry.go

Pattern B -- Embedded AudioAsset (audio_script.riv, typeKey=406):
  - AudioAsset(406) -> FileAssetContents(106) with raw audio bytes (same as ImageAsset pattern)
  - Larger files (audio_script.riv = 1.28MB with embedded audio)
  - typeKey 406 already registered in gen_registry.go

=== PARENTID SEMANTICS (artboard-relative) ===
parentId on Event/CustomProperty children works the same as all artboard children:
  global_index = artboard_global_index + parentId_value
Example: Event "Footstep" at global [16], artboard at [1]
  artboard-relative index of Footstep = 16 - 1 = 15
  CustomProperty child uses parentId=15 -> global 1+15=16 = "Footstep" (correct)
